risks.title: Dependency deprecation warnings
risks.description: joblib emits NumPy 2.5 deprecation warnings during model deserialization.
risks.treatment: Track dependency compatibility and upgrade after regression validation.

risks.title: Simulation-only infrastructure controls
risks.description: Deployment, failover, rollback, and traffic progression remain simulated.
risks.treatment: Require separate infrastructure integration and authorization before production use.

risks.title: Synthetic incident data
risks.description: Model and workflow validation use synthetic incident records.
risks.treatment: Perform domain acceptance testing with governed production-representative data in v2.
